title: Depth vs. Breadth Activity Map
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Plot activities by years of involvement and weekly hours to see the difference between a deep activity profile and a broad one, then plot your own.

learningObjectives: Students will compare activity profiles by years of involvement and weekly hours, and distinguish a profile that shows depth from one that shows breadth alone.

controls: Show Applicant A, Show Applicant B, and Show both buttons
Activity form: name, years, hours per week, weeks per year, leadership checkbox
Add / Save changes, Cancel edit, and Clear mine buttons

keyQuestions: Why can four activities tell a reader more than ten?
Does an activity have to be in the depth zone to be worth listing?
What counts as a 'growing role' if you don't have a title?
commonMisconceptions: More activities always make a stronger application.
Only formal leadership titles show growth.
assessmentOpportunities: Students distinguish a deep profile from a broad one using years, hours, and role, and identify one of their own activities with the most depth.
